tagline.value: Oral medicines that restore the gut barrier
tagline.quote: Oral medicines that restore the gut barrier

items.text: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) affects 6.8 million people worldwide, and annual direct costs of IBD care exceed $25 billion in the US.
quotes: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) affects 6.8 million people worldwide.
Annual direct costs of IBD care exceed $25 billion in the US.

items.text: Up to 40% of patients lose response to biologic therapy within the first year, and no approved therapy directly repairs the damaged intestinal barrier.
quotes: Up to 40% of patients lose response to biologic therapy within the first year.
No approved therapy directly repairs the damaged intestinal barrier.

items.text: Barrier damage persists in many patients in clinical remission and predicts relapse, leaving a root cause of disease unaddressed.
quotes: Barrier damage persists in many patients in clinical remission and predicts relapse.

items.text: HT-101 is an oral, gut-restricted small molecule designed to restore tight-junction integrity, targeting the epithelial barrier rather than suppressing the immune system.
quotes: HT-101 is an oral, gut-restricted small molecule that restores tight-junction integrity.
Platform targets the epithelial barrier rather than suppressing the immune system.

items.text: Designed as a once-daily oral tablet for use alone or alongside existing biologics; minimal systemic exposure has been observed in preclinical models.
quotes: Designed as a once-daily oral tablet for use alone or alongside existing biologics.
Minimal systemic exposure observed in preclinical models.
